_readme: Source directory for the public Wire page.
A source renders as a link ONLY when verified is true. Everything else
renders as plain text. Run scripts/check-wire.mjs to probe each URL; it sets
verified only on a live 200. Adding a URL by hand without running the check
changes nothing on the site, which is deliberate.
Only 404 and 410 mean dead. A 403 is a bot wall and a 5xx is a bad day.

groups.name: Primary — Australia
groups.why: Where the number is actually published. Everything downstream is someone's reading of these.
